headword: {実力主義|じつりょくしゅぎ}

definitions.gloss: meritocracy; merit-based system; principle of rewarding ability
definitions.explanation: A system or philosophy that evaluates and rewards people based on their actual ability and performance rather than seniority, connections, or background.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実力主義|じつりょくしゅぎ}だ。

{実力主義|じつりょくしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In a merit-based workplace, you can be promoted regardless of age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{実力主義|じつりょくしゅぎ}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{移行|いこう}→移行：13776_ikou⟧しつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese companies are also transitioning from seniority-based to merit-based systems.

notes:
USAGE:
Often discussed in contrast with ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧ (seniority system), which has been the traditional model in Japanese companies. The shift toward {実力主義|じつりょくしゅぎ} is a major topic in Japanese business culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実力主義|じつりょくしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (a merit-based company)
- {実力主義|じつりょくしゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧ (to introduce a merit-based system)
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{実力主義|じつりょくしゅぎ} (pure meritocracy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧: seniority system — the traditional Japanese counterpart
- {能力主義|のうりょくしゅぎ}: ability-based principle — near synonym
